fusions.name: Catchpole
fusions.desc: Thrusts a closing collar on the end of the staff at a target up to 4 tiles away. It deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Bar Set
fusions.desc: Drives the staff into the ground beside the target as the last bar. It deals 16 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each one, then leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Driven Palings
fusions.desc: Drives a row of staves into the ground as a wall 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it, and anything that touches it moves 25% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: No Gap Between
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. Your armour rises by 6%.
